title: MZ VisuStella Menu Core hidden items/misplaced image

posts.author: EternalFox
posts.body:
I'm using Visustella pluggin menu core; under items some new tabs have been added; one of which is materials. All my hidden items now show up under materials and I can't figure out how to change this or specify what gets placed in which category.
Also, the TP bar covers the health bar under the equipment menu; how can i get rid of the TP bar?

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: This thread was moved from RPG Maker MZ Support to JavaScript/Plugin Support.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
EternalFox said:
I'm using Visustella pluggin menu core; under items some new tabs have been added; one of which is materials.
Click to expand...
No, it didn't - the Item Scene is completely separate from the Menu Scene. The Menu Core has no effect on the item list at all.
EternalFox said:
All my hidden items now show up under materials and I can't figure out how to change this or specify what gets placed in which category.
Click to expand...
You would have to figure out which plugin you're using to add that, then go into the plugin parameters or check the plugin instructions to change it.
EternalFox said:
Also, the TP bar covers the health bar under the equipment menu; how can i get rid of the TP bar?
Click to expand...
Same as above - this plugin does not affect the Equip Scene.
